newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease, seen treading water.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease, seen treading water.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.14 percent on Friday and traders said the market was likely to tread water over the next few weeks as domestic investors continued to eye the return of foreign capital.
"In the next week shares could move up or down by a maximum two to three percent, and the status quo could last for another two weeks," said Andrej Obed, a trader at "A" banka.
Brokers said the market was ripe for further declines in the long run if foreign investors continued to watch from the sidelines.
* The blue-chip SBI index eased 1.86 points to 1,334.6.

* Health resort operator and mineral water producer Radenska was the most actively traded issue, firming 0.31 percent to 1,928 tolars on volume of 12,895 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
